premises.text: App users need data continuity across devices, which requires a backend developers struggle to get cheaply and cross-platform
premises.evidence_span: lack of data continuity across devices

premises.text: Nimbus Base stores app data on users' personal clouds such as Dropbox and Google Drive instead of developer-owned servers
premises.evidence_span: leverage app users' personal clouds, like Dropbox and Google Drive, to store app data

premises.text: Data syncs across web and mobile with local offline store then cloud sync when online
premises.evidence_span: If you're offline, that data is first stored locally and then synced to be online when you do have a connection

premises.text: Users retain delete control over their app data in their own personal cloud
premises.evidence_span: you can personally delete your data for your apps

premises.text: Developers integrate with a few lines of code, cut backend setup from months to minutes, and avoid storage costs at scale
premises.evidence_span: reduces the time developers spend setting up a back end from months to minutes

premises.text: Developers pay for a license while app users do not pay for the personal-cloud backend
premises.evidence_span: it's a developer who pays for a license and not the app user

value.text: Users get seamless cross-device app data while developers get an easy free-to-scale backend
value.evidence_span: a back end that's easy to implement, free to scale, and works everywhere

secondary_value.text: Users keep complete control over their private app data
secondary_value.evidence_span: lets you have complete control over all your data

causal_links.evidence_span: Because we build on top of personal cloud API, we completely remove the server from the app development equation
app users expect to have access to their most recent data anytime, anywhere
data is instantly synced between the two
scale from one user to millions for free

notes: iCloud/build-yourself/BaaS alternatives motivate P1/P2 rather than separate premises. Time-saving and storage-cost-saving folded into P5 as one developer-economics package of the personal-cloud approach. Free beta signup treated as GTM detail.
